faqs.q: Is Base64 encoding the same as encryption?

faqs.q: What is the difference between 401 and 403?

faqs.q: When should I use 200 vs 201 vs 204?

faqs.q: How do I calculate the number of hosts in a subnet?

faqs.q: What cost factor should I use for bcrypt?

faqs.q: Is bcrypt better than SHA-256 for passwords?
faqs.a: Yes. SHA-256 is designed to be fast, which makes it vulnerable to brute-force attacks. Bcrypt is intentionally slow and includes a built-in salt, making it much more secure for password storage.

json-to-go.seoContent: Go의 엄격한 타입 시스템은 JSON 데이터를 언마셜링하기 전에 구조체를 정의해야 합니다. 이 도구는 JSON을 분석하여 적절한 필드명, 올바른 Go 타입, 직렬화용 json 구조 태그를 가진 관용적 Go 구조체 정의를 생성합니다. 모든 처리는 브라우저에서 수행됩니다.

svg-to-jsx.seoContent: React에서 SVG 아이콘과 그래픽을 사용하려면 SVG 속성을 JSX 호환 구문으로 변환해야 합니다. 이 도구는 이러한 변환을 자동으로 처리합니다. 디자인 도구의 SVG를 재사용 가능한 React 아이콘 컴포넌트로 변환하는 데 적합합니다.

faqs.a: 모든 케밥케이스 SVG 속성이 카멜케이스로 변환됩니다: stroke-width → strokeWidth 등 40개 이상의 속성.

css-to-tailwind.seoContent: Tailwind CSS는 커스텀 CSS 대신 사전 정의된 클래스를 사용하는 유틸리티 우선 CSS 프레임워크입니다. 이 도구는 display, position, flexbox, grid, 스페이싱, 타이포그래피, 색상, 테두리 등의 일반적인 CSS 속성을 자동 변환합니다.

Tailwind의 임의 값 구문으로 변환: color: #ff5733 → text-[#ff5733].
각 규칙 내 CSS 속성을 변환합니다. 반응형 클래스(sm:, md:, lg:)는 수동으로 추가해야 합니다.

faqs.q: 셀렉터가 있는 CSS를 붙여넣을 수 있나요?

json-to-graphql.name: JSON to GraphQL
json-to-graphql.description: Convert JSON data to GraphQL schema definitions
json-to-graphql.pageDescription: Convert JSON to GraphQL type definitions online. Generate accurate GraphQL schemas from JSON data with nested types and arrays. Free and instant.
json-to-graphql.seoContent: GraphQL uses a strongly-typed schema to define the shape of data available through an API. When designing a GraphQL API, you often start with sample JSON data from an existing REST endpoint or database. This tool analyzes your JSON structure and generates the corresponding GraphQL type definitions. It maps JavaScript types to GraphQL scalars (String, Int, Float, Boolean), creates separate type blocks for nested objects, and handles arrays as list types. The generated schema can serve as a starting point for your GraphQL server implementation. All processing happens locally in your browser.

faqs.q: How does JSON to GraphQL conversion work?
faqs.a: The tool analyzes your JSON structure and maps each field to the appropriate GraphQL type. Strings become String, numbers become Int or Float, booleans become Boolean, nested objects become separate types, and arrays become list types.

faqs.q: Does it generate a complete GraphQL schema?
faqs.a: It generates type definitions that you can use in your schema. You may need to add custom resolvers, mutations, and input types depending on your API design.
Nested objects are extracted into separate named types. For example, a user with an address object will generate both a User type and an Address type.

faqs.q: Is the output ready to use in a GraphQL server?
faqs.a: The generated types are valid GraphQL SDL (Schema Definition Language) and can be used directly in servers like Apollo, Yoga, or any SDL-first GraphQL framework.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JSON data into the input panel
Set the root type name (default: Root)
Click Convert to generate GraphQL types
Copy the schema into your GraphQL server
useCases: Designing GraphQL schemas from existing REST API responses
Prototyping GraphQL types from sample data
Generating type definitions for GraphQL code generators

json-to-java.name: JSON to Java Class
json-to-java.description: Convert JSON data to Java class definitions
json-to-java.pageDescription: Convert JSON to Java POJO classes online. Generate Java classes with getters, setters, and Lombok support. Free, fast, and private.
json-to-java.seoContent: Java's strong type system requires defining classes before deserializing JSON data. Manually writing Java POJOs (Plain Old Java Objects) for complex JSON APIs is tedious and error-prone. This tool analyzes your JSON and generates complete Java class definitions with proper field types, constructors, getters, and setters. It supports Lombok's @Data annotation to reduce boilerplate. Nested objects become separate classes, arrays become List<Type>, and null values are handled with nullable types. All processing happens in your browser.

faqs.q: How do I convert JSON to Java classes?
faqs.a: Paste your JSON data, set a root class name, and click Convert. The tool generates Java POJO classes with proper types, fields, constructors, getters, and setters.
When enabled, the tool adds Lombok's @Data annotation which auto-generates getters, setters, toString, equals, and hashCode methods, significantly reducing boilerplate code.
JSON arrays are converted to List<Type> with appropriate generic types. The tool adds the java.util.List import automatically.

faqs.q: Can I use the generated classes directly?
faqs.a: Yes. The output is valid Java code ready to use with Jackson, Gson, or any JSON library. Just copy into .java files.

howToUseSteps: Paste your JSON data into the input panel
Set the root class name (default: Root)
Toggle Lombok support if desired
Copy the generated Java classes into your project

json-to-kotlin.name: JSON to Kotlin
json-to-kotlin.description: Convert JSON data to Kotlin data classes
json-to-kotlin.pageTitle: JSON to Kotlin Data Class Converter
json-to-kotlin.pageDescription: Convert JSON to Kotlin data classes online. Generate idiomatic Kotlin code with nullable types and proper type inference. Free and instant.
json-to-kotlin.seoContent: Kotlin data classes provide a concise way to define typed data models. When working with JSON APIs in Kotlin (especially on Android), you need data classes that match the JSON structure. This tool analyzes your JSON and generates idiomatic Kotlin data classes with proper type inference. It handles nullable types for null values, uses List<Type> for arrays, and creates separate data classes for nested objects. The generated code works seamlessly with Kotlinx.serialization, Moshi, or Gson. All processing happens locally in your browser.

faqs.q: How do I convert JSON to Kotlin data classes?
faqs.a: Paste your JSON, set the root class name, and click Convert. The tool generates Kotlin data classes with proper types for each field.
Fields with null values are typed as nullable (String?). You can also enable the nullable option to make all fields nullable.

faqs.q: Does it work with Android development?
faqs.a: Yes. The generated data classes are compatible with Retrofit, Moshi, Gson, and Kotlinx.serialization commonly used in Android apps.
Nested JSON objects become separate Kotlin data classes. For example, an address field generates both a Root data class and an Address data class.

json-to-python.description: Convert JSON data to Python dataclass or TypedDict
json-to-python.pageDescription: Convert JSON to Python dataclasses or TypedDict online. Generate typed Python code with proper type hints. Free, fast, and private.
json-to-python.seoContent: Python's dataclasses and TypedDict provide structured ways to define typed data models. When consuming JSON APIs in Python, having properly typed classes improves code quality and IDE support. This tool analyzes your JSON and generates Python dataclasses with type hints or TypedDict definitions. It maps types correctly (str, int, float, bool, Optional, List), converts field names to snake_case, and creates separate classes for nested objects. The generated code includes proper imports from dataclasses and typing modules. All processing happens in your browser.

faqs.q: What's the difference between dataclass and TypedDict?
faqs.a: Dataclasses create full Python classes with __init__, __repr__, etc. TypedDict defines dictionary shapes for type checking without creating a class. Use dataclass for objects, TypedDict for JSON-like dicts.
camelCase and PascalCase field names are automatically converted to snake_case following Python naming conventions.

faqs.q: Can I use this with Pydantic?
faqs.a: The dataclass output is close to Pydantic models. You can easily adapt it by changing @dataclass to inherit from pydantic.BaseModel.

howToUseSteps: Browse colors by group or search
Click a swatch to view details
Copy the Tailwind class name
Copy HEX, RGB, or HSL values
useCases: Getting hex values for Tailwind colors

faqs.q: Is this the official Tailwind palette?
faqs.a: Yes, all colors match the Tailwind CSS v3 default color palette.
Tailwind class name, HEX, RGB, and HSL values.

curl-to-code.name: cURL 코드 변환기
curl-to-code.description: cURL 명령을 Python, JavaScript 등으로 변환
curl-to-code.pageDescription: cURL 명령을 Python, JavaScript, Go, PHP 코드로 변환합니다.
curl-to-code.seoTitle: What is a cURL to Code Converter?
curl-to-code.seoContent: A cURL to code converter translates cURL commands from API documentation or browser DevTools into equivalent code in your preferred programming language.
howToUseSteps: Paste a cURL command
Select target language
View generated code
Copy the code

faqs.a: Python, JavaScript (fetch/axios), Go, PHP, Ruby, Java, C#, and more.

faqs.q: Can I paste cURL from Chrome DevTools?
faqs.a: Yes, copy as cURL from Chrome Network tab and paste directly.

yaml-validator.name: YAML 검증기
yaml-validator.pageDescription: YAML 구문 검사, 오류 표시, 자동 포맷을 지원합니다.
yaml-validator.seoContent: A YAML validator checks your YAML files for syntax errors, indentation issues, and formatting problems. Essential for DevOps and configuration management.
howToUseSteps: Paste YAML content
View validation results
Fix highlighted errors
Copy formatted YAML

faqs.a: Yes, documents separated by --- are validated independently.
Yes, indentation issues are highlighted with specific line numbers.

gitignore-generator.name: .gitignore 생성기
gitignore-generator.pageDescription: Node.js, Python, Java 등의 .gitignore 파일을 생성합니다.
gitignore-generator.seoContent: A .gitignore generator creates customized .gitignore files by combining templates for your programming language, framework, IDE, and operating system.
howToUseSteps: Search for your language or framework
Select multiple templates
Preview the combined .gitignore
Copy or download the file

faqs.a: Yes, select multiple languages, frameworks, and IDEs to combine them.

faqs.q: Are the templates up to date?
faqs.a: Templates follow GitHub's official gitignore repository patterns.

json-to-dart.name: JSON to Dart
json-to-dart.pageDescription: JSON 데이터를 null-safe Dart 클래스로 변환합니다.
json-to-dart.seoContent: JSON to Dart converts JSON API responses into Dart model classes with serialization methods, making Flutter development faster and type-safe.
howToUseSteps: Paste JSON data
Set root class name
Choose options (null safety, etc.)
Copy generated Dart code

faqs.a: Yes, generated classes use Dart null safety with nullable types where appropriate.
Yes, nested objects generate separate classes with proper references.

nginx-config.name: Nginx 설정 생성기
nginx-config.pageDescription: 리버스 프록시, SSL, 정적 사이트용 Nginx 설정을 생성합니다.
nginx-config.seoTitle: What is an Nginx Config Generator?
nginx-config.seoContent: An Nginx config generator creates production-ready server configuration files with proper security headers, SSL, and reverse proxy settings.
howToUseSteps: Select server type (reverse proxy, static, etc.)
Configure domain and ports
Enable SSL and security options
Copy the generated config

faqs.a: Yes, with Let's Encrypt compatible settings, HSTS, and modern cipher suites.

faqs.q: Can I configure multiple server blocks?
faqs.a: The generator creates a single server block. Add multiple blocks manually.

htaccess-generator.name: .htaccess 생성기
htaccess-generator.pageDescription: 301 리다이렉트, HTTPS 강제, 보안 헤더용 .htaccess를 생성합니다.
htaccess-generator.seoContent: An .htaccess generator creates Apache configuration files for URL redirects, security headers, caching rules, and access control without editing the main server config.
howToUseSteps: Select features to enable
Configure redirects and rules
Preview the .htaccess code
Copy and upload to your server

faqs.q: Does it work with all Apache servers?
faqs.a: Yes, if mod_rewrite is enabled (standard on most hosts).

faqs.q: Can I use this for WordPress?
faqs.a: Yes, the generated rules work alongside WordPress .htaccess rules.

docker-compose-generator.name: Docker Compose 생성기
docker-compose-generator.pageDescription: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB 프리셋으로 docker-compose.yml을 구축합니다.
docker-compose-generator.seoTitle: What is a Docker Compose Generator?
docker-compose-generator.seoContent: A Docker Compose generator helps you build docker-compose.yml files visually by selecting pre-configured service templates and customizing settings.
howToUseSteps: Add services from presets
Configure ports and volumes
Set environment variables
Copy the docker-compose.yml

faqs.a: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Nginx, Node.js, Python, and more.
Yes, the output is valid docker-compose.yml that can be used directly.

json-to-protobuf.name: JSON to Protobuf
json-to-protobuf.pageDescription: JSON 데이터를 Protocol Buffers (.proto) 스키마로 변환합니다.
json-to-protobuf.seoContent: JSON to Protobuf converts JSON sample data into Protocol Buffer schema definitions (.proto files) used in gRPC microservices and high-performance APIs.
howToUseSteps: Paste JSON data
Set package and message name
Review generated .proto schema
Copy the schema

faqs.q: What protobuf syntax version is used?
faqs.a: Proto3 syntax is generated by default.
Yes, JSON arrays are converted to repeated fields automatically.

csp-generator.name: CSP 헤더 생성기
csp-generator.seoContent: A Content-Security-Policy generator helps you build CSP headers that protect your website from XSS, data injection, and other code injection attacks.
howToUseSteps: Select a preset or start from scratch
Configure each directive
Add trusted sources
Copy the CSP header

faqs.a: All standard CSP directives including default-src, script-src, style-src, img-src, and more.
Use report-uri directive for monitoring. This tool generates the header you need.

sql-to-prisma.name: SQL to Prisma
sql-to-prisma.pageDescription: SQL CREATE TABLE 문을 Prisma 스키마 모델로 변환합니다.
sql-to-prisma.seoContent: SQL to Prisma converts existing SQL database schemas into Prisma schema format, making it easy to adopt Prisma ORM in TypeScript/Node.js projects.
howToUseSteps: Paste SQL CREATE TABLE statements
Select SQL dialect (MySQL/PostgreSQL)
Review generated Prisma schema
Copy the schema

faqs.a: MySQL and PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE syntax.
Yes, foreign key constraints are converted to Prisma @relation directives.
